verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a Git forge such as Gitea, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents acting on many items at once, such as bulk-editing issues, labels or repositories. The API, webhooks, the tea CLI and the MCP server are only building blocks a user could script bulk actions with, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
